map-sidebar-main-panel.proportion-habitat-within-protected-area: Proportion of Habitat within Protected and Conserved Areas
map-sidebar-main-panel.custom-area-description: Activate more layers for additional contextual information about your custom area conservation scenario.
map-sidebar-main-panel.max-layers-reached: Maximum of {max} custom layers reached. Remove a layer to add more.
map-sidebar-main-panel.invalid-geometry-for-stats: The uploaded layer has an invalid geometry and cannot be used for statistics calculation.
map-sidebar-main-panel.draw-upload-directions: Draw or upload a shape on the map to build a custom conservation scenario
map-sidebar-main-panel.draw-step-1-description: Click on the Draw shape button located below.
map-sidebar-main-panel.draw-step-2-description: Start drawing on the map by clicking. Each click adds an anchor point to the shape.
map-sidebar-main-panel.draw-step-3-description: Complete the shape you drew by clicking on the first anchor point you added or by double clicking on the last anchor point.
map-sidebar-main-panel.draw-step-4-description: Drawn shapes will be added to the Map Layers panel, where you can save the layer to your browser, or remove it.
map-sidebar-main-panel.upload-step-1-description: Click on the Upload layer button located below.
map-sidebar-main-panel.upload-step-2-description: Select a file from your computer that is 5Mb or smaller. Only GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, SHP (with associated files), and PRJ file types are accepted.
map-sidebar-main-panel.upload-step-3-description: For statistics calculation, files must contain at least one polygon or multipolygon with valid geometries. Files with other geometries or topology errors cannot be used for statistics, but can be added to the map as context layers.
map-sidebar-main-panel.upload-step-4-description: Uploaded layers will be added to the Map Layers panel, where you can select which layer to calculate statistics on by clicking on the icon. Only layers with this icon are eligible for statistics calculation. You can also save layers to your browser to revisit later, or remove them.
map-sidebar-main-panel.empty-custom-region: Add countries to your Custom Region by selecting them on the map and clicking the <addIcon></addIcon> icon, or by clicking on <searchIcon></searchIcon> Change Location and choosing from the list of countries in the Custom Region tab.
map-sidebar-main-panel.add-country-custom-region: Add Countries to Your Custom Region to See Stats
map-sidebar-main-panel.overlapping-eez-explainer: Some selected countries may have overlapping EEZs (red dashed outline), which could affect statistics. Reach out to us to request analysis.
